children: SCB X's solid dividend yields and earnings growth over FY 2026-FY 2028 back CGS International's rating upgrade to add from hold for the Thai financial company's stock. The Thai company's 3Q asset quality mostly improved, with sequentially lower new nonperforming loan formation in all loan segments besides its auto-title lending subsidiary, analyst Weerapat Wonk-urai says in a note. He projects the company's FY 2026-FY 2028 earnings to grow 5.9%-7.5%, while its dividend yields are likely to stand at 7.0%-8.0%. CGSI also raises its target price to 163.0 baht from 160.0 baht. Shares rise 2.4% to 150.50 baht. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
